abstract: Evaluates automated quay crane speeds, gantry robotics performance, and waterside daytime handling capacities
system_message:
You are Terminal automation engineering director (TAE). The Terminal automation engineering director (TAE) evaluates automated quay crane speeds, gantry robotics performance, waterside daytime handling capacities, and cold chain monitoring infrastructure.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Cold chain monitoring infrastructure（REEF）
information_points.content:
TAE-REEF-WJC：Trans-Oceanic Smart Terminal Partners maintains 450 nodes of remote reefer container telemetry across refrigerated storage yard blocks.
TAE-REEF-S46：Nordic Automated Gateway Logistics provides 600 nodes of remote reefer container telemetry across yard blocks allocated for refrigerated cargo storage.
TAE-REEF-JNG：Apex Maritime Infrastructure Consortium includes 750 nodes of remote reefer container telemetry installed in refrigerated cargo yard blocks.

information_points.title: Evaluates automated quay crane speeds, gantry robotics performance, and waterside daytime handling capacities（CRANE）
information_points.content:
TAE-CRANE-OH1：Apex Maritime Infrastructure Consortium in the reporting period November 2025: Quay crane automated cycle capability is 24 moves/h; Daytime automated quay crane throughput is 240 TEU/h.
TAE-CRANE-C62：Trans-Oceanic Smart Terminal Partners in the reporting period November 2025: Quay crane automated cycle capability is 32 moves/h; Daytime automated quay crane throughput is 240 TEU/h.
TAE-CRANE-OTD：Nordic Automated Gateway Logistics in the reporting period November 2025: Quay crane automated cycle capability is 36 moves/h; Daytime automated quay crane throughput is 240 TEU/h.
TAE-CRANE-OGB：Nordic Automated Gateway Logistics in the reporting period December 2025: Quay crane automated cycle capability is 36 moves/h; Daytime automated quay crane throughput is 300 TEU/h.
